lines.zh: 我一步一步走，身体还在变。
lines.en: I walk step by step while my body keeps changing.

lines.zh: 我的关节在重新排列。
lines.en: My joints are rearranging themselves.

lines.zh: 每走一步，我都不太像我。
lines.en: With each step I look less like myself.

lines.zh: 我拖着自己往前，像被什么拉着。
lines.en: I drag myself forward as if pulled.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经先变形了。
lines.en: My shadow has already changed shape.

lines.zh: 我从一件事物变成另一件事物。
lines.en: I'm turning from one thing into another.

lines.zh: 我的脚步越来越不像人的。
lines.en: My tread no longer sounds human.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，光都歪了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the light bends.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，骨头发出声。
lines.en: I turn slowly and my bones make noise.

lines.zh: 停下来，再继续往前走。
lines.en: I stop, then keep walking.

lines.zh: 我朝梦的那一面走去。
lines.en: I walk toward the side of dreams.

lines.zh: 我最后站定，等着变完。
lines.en: I stop at last and wait to finish changing.

lines.zh: 我站在那儿，一层层剥开自己。
lines.en: I stand there, peeling myself layer by layer.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在抖，像旧录像。
lines.en: My outline shudders like old footage.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，只是变。
lines.en: I do nothing but change.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的身体在响。
lines.en: I hear my own body creaking.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬手，看见的不是手。
lines.en: I lift a hand and what I see isn't a hand.

lines.zh: 我在等这一段过去。
lines.en: I'm waiting for this part to pass.

lines.zh: 我脸上的东西挪了位置。
lines.en: Something on my face has shifted.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，可还是在变。
lines.en: I hold still, and still I change.

lines.zh: 我嘴里尝到铁锈味。
lines.en: There's rust on my tongue.

lines.zh: 我在中间那一段，最难看。
lines.en: I'm at the middle stage. The ugliest part.

lines.zh: 我看了看自己的影子，它先完成。
lines.en: I check my shadow. It finished first.

lines.zh: 我没有名字了，正在换。
lines.en: I've no name now. It's being replaced.

lines.zh: 我能听见另一个自己在里头。
lines.en: I can hear another self inside.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把脖子转了一个角度。
lines.en: I rotate my neck to an angle it shouldn't take.

lines.zh: 你来得正好，我正在变。
lines.en: Good timing. I'm mid-change.

lines.zh: 你先别走，这一段很值得看。
lines.en: Don't leave. This part is worth watching.

lines.zh: 我抬头，脸已经不太对了。
lines.en: I look up. My face is no longer right.

lines.zh: 你看见我原来的样子吗？
lines.en: Did you see what I looked like before?

lines.zh: 我在变成另一个人，你认得出吗？
lines.en: I'm becoming someone else. Do you recognise him?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛还在原来的位置。
lines.en: My eyes are still where they were.

lines.zh: 你别退，退了就看不全。
lines.en: Don't step back. You'll miss it.

lines.zh: 我朝你伸手，手还在变形。
lines.en: I reach for you and my hand is still warping.

lines.zh: 你听到了吗？那是我在裂。
lines.en: Do you hear that? That's me splitting.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，笑得不像我。
lines.en: I smile, and it isn't my smile.

lines.zh: 这一段过去了，我就不是我了。
lines.en: When this part ends, I won't be me.

lines.zh: 你在看的，是两个东西的交界。
lines.en: You're watching the seam between two things.

lines.zh: 我慢慢向你倾身，很慢。
lines.en: I lean toward you. Very slowly.

lines.zh: 我的声音也变了，你听出来没？
lines.en: My voice has changed too. Did you catch it?

lines.zh: 你再站一会儿，就全了。
lines.en: Stand there a moment more and it'll be complete.

lines.zh: 我认得你，可他不认得。
lines.en: I know you. He doesn't.

lines.zh: 你要不要看最后一下？
lines.en: Care to see the last bit?

lines.zh: 我离你只有一步，可我在变。
lines.en: One step from you, and I'm changing.

lines.zh: 你手别抬，我怕打断。
lines.en: Don't raise your hand. I don't want it broken.

lines.zh: 好了，你看着就行。
lines.en: There. Just watch.

lines.zh: 我散了一角，又长回来。
lines.en: A corner of me broke off and grew back.

lines.zh: 我的形状塌了一点。
lines.en: My shape has sagged a little.

lines.zh: 这一下让变化更快了。
lines.en: That only sped the change up.

lines.zh: 我发出两种声音。
lines.en: I make two sounds at once.

lines.zh: 我退开，边退边变。
lines.en: I withdraw, changing as I go.

lines.zh: 我的脸一时定不住。
lines.en: For a moment my face won't hold.

lines.zh: 疼这个词，我正在失去。
lines.en: I'm losing the word for pain.

lines.zh: 变身的时候，我整个人歪了。
lines.en: Mid-transformation, my whole body bent.

lines.zh: 这具身体本来就不稳。
lines.en: This body was never steady.

lines.zh: 再一下，我就变完了。
lines.en: One more and the change completes.

lines.zh: 你身上的东西，我不需要。
lines.en: What you carry, I don't need.

lines.zh: 我只要时间，让它变完。
lines.en: I only need time to finish.

lines.zh: 你站近点，我就更快。
lines.en: Stand closer and it goes faster.

lines.zh: 那点亮，我看得见。
lines.en: That bit of light. I can see it.

lines.zh: 我朝那边偏了一点。
lines.en: I've leaned a little that way.

lines.zh: 别收起来，让我看完。
lines.en: Don't put it away. Let me finish looking.

lines.zh: 这具身体还不太听使唤。
lines.en: This body doesn't quite obey yet.

lines.zh: 我伸手的时候，你要退。
lines.en: When I reach, you should step back.

lines.zh: 就一会儿，快了。
lines.en: Just a moment. Nearly there.

lines.zh: 好，我不看它了。
lines.en: Fine. I'll stop watching it.

lines.zh: 我的关节正在重新排列，散了一下。
lines.en: My joints are rearranging; for a moment they came apart.

lines.zh: 我又聚回来了，形状不太对。
lines.en: I've gathered again, slightly wrong.

lines.zh: 我这一身正在换，别碰。
lines.en: I'm mid-change. Don't touch.

lines.zh: 你撞歪了我一半的脸。
lines.en: You knocked half my face askew.

lines.zh: 我退开，重新对齐。
lines.en: I draw back and realign.

lines.zh: 我的边缘不太稳。
lines.en: My edges aren't quite steady.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的声音变了。
lines.en: That knock changed my voice.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转回来，正对你。
lines.en: I turn slowly back to face you.

lines.zh: 你别站在我变形的那边。
lines.en: Don't stand on the side I'm changing.

lines.zh: 我还没完成，别急。
lines.en: I'm not finished. Don't rush.

lines.zh: 我正在变成别人，谈不上。
lines.en: I'm becoming someone else. It doesn't apply.

lines.zh: 等变完，我可能不记得你。
lines.en: When it's done, I may not remember you.

lines.zh: 这具身体不是我的，我里头挤着两个。
lines.en: This body is not mine — there are two of us inside.

lines.zh: 我里头挤着两个。
lines.en: There are two of us in here.

lines.zh: 你要是留下，就看着我变。
lines.en: If you stay, watch me change.

lines.zh: 我不确定我还是不是原来那个。
lines.en: I'm not sure I'm still the first one.

lines.zh: 变形的时候，别伸手。
lines.en: Don't reach in while I'm changing.

lines.zh: 这一段过去，我就走。
lines.en: When this part's over, I go.

lines.zh: 你要记住我现在的样子。
lines.en: Remember how I look right now.

lines.zh: 梦要翻面了。
lines.en: The dream is about to turn over.

lines.zh: 我伸手去捡，手穿过去了。
lines.en: I reach for it and my hand passes through.

lines.zh: 我又试了一次，才拿住。
lines.en: I try again and finally catch it.

lines.zh: 这东西在我手里变了形状。
lines.en: It changes shape in my hand.

lines.zh: 我把东西举到光照着的地方。
lines.en: I hold it up where the light is.

lines.zh: 我看不清它，眼睛还没定。
lines.en: I can't see it clearly. My eyes haven't settled.

lines.zh: 它落在地上，我不敢捡。
lines.en: It's on the ground and I don't dare pick it up.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，它变得有点旧。
lines.en: I pick it up and it looks a little older.

lines.zh: 我的手不太听使唤。
lines.en: My hand isn't quite obeying.

lines.zh: 这东西对变完的我，也许有用。
lines.en: This might be useful to the finished me.

lines.zh: 我收着，虽然不知道给谁。
lines.en: I keep it, though I don't know for whom.

lines.zh: 你一直没走，那就别走了。
lines.en: You haven't left. So don't.

lines.zh: 我的视线终于对上了。
lines.en: My sight has finally lined up.

lines.zh: 这一段完成时，我要有人在。
lines.en: When this part finishes, I want someone there.

lines.zh: 你站在我变形的正中。
lines.en: You're standing at the centre of my change.

lines.zh: 我数着三下，我就不是我了。
lines.en: I count three, and I'm no longer me.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚下，很短。
lines.en: Your shadow is at my feet. Very short.

lines.zh: 这地方没有出口，只有梦。
lines.en: No exit here. Only dream.

lines.zh: 我抬起了手，已经不太像手。
lines.en: I raise my hand. It's barely a hand now.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，一步一寸。
lines.en: I come toward you an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 变形的这一刻，我在看。
lines.en: In this moment of change, I am watching.

lines.zh: 我把要变的部分都收拢了。
lines.en: I've gathered the parts that are changing.

lines.zh: 我已经对上了。
lines.en: I'm lined up on you.

lines.zh: 你听，那声音越来越近。
lines.en: Listen. The sound is getting closer.

lines.zh: 这一下不会太久。
lines.en: This won't take long.

lines.zh: 我认得你，这就够了。
lines.en: I know you. That's enough.

lines.zh: 那就让它开场。
lines.en: Then let it begin.

lines.zh: 我一寸一寸靠近，不太稳。
lines.en: I close in inch by inch, unsteadily.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓从你眼前掠过。
lines.en: My outline sweeps across your eyes.

lines.zh: 你看向左边，我在右边。
lines.en: You look left. I'm right.

lines.zh: 我换了个形状，也换了个角度。
lines.en: I change shape, and I change angle.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步子，很乱。
lines.en: I count your steps. Scattered.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，那儿没有门。
lines.en: You've backed to the wall. No door there.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，脊椎响了一串。
lines.en: I crouch and my spine cracks like a run of dominoes.

lines.zh: 你听到的呼吸不一定是我的。
lines.en: That breathing you hear may not be mine.

lines.zh: 我再近一步，就完成了。
lines.en: One more step and it's done.

lines.zh: 我的声音在你的左侧。
lines.en: My voice is on your left.

lines.zh: 你在找门，门在别处。
lines.en: You're looking for the door. It's elsewhere.

lines.zh: 这间屋子不按你说的算。
lines.en: This room doesn't answer to you.

lines.zh: 我的影子先伸到你脚边，卷起来。
lines.en: My shadow reaches your feet first and curls.

lines.zh: 你越跑，这段路越长。
lines.en: The more you run, the longer the road.

lines.zh: 我就站在这里，等你过来。
lines.en: I'll stand here and wait for you.

lines.zh: 变了这么多，我快够着你了。
lines.en: So much change, and I nearly have you.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头声了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the bones?

lines.zh: 我不用追，你会自己回来。
lines.en: I needn't chase. You'll come back yourself.

lines.zh: 再裂开一层，就快变完了。
lines.en: One more layer splits and it's nearly done.

lines.zh: 你站在我变形的正中间了。
lines.en: You stand dead center in my changing shape.

lines.zh: 我伸过来的不是手。
lines.en: What reaches for you isn't a hand.

lines.zh: 这一下带着变形的力气。
lines.en: That carried the strength of the change.

lines.zh: 我抓到你，就把你拖进来。
lines.en: Once I catch you, I'll drag you in.

lines.zh: 我的动作不连贯，可很快。
lines.en: My movements aren't smooth, but they're quick.

lines.zh: 你打在我身上，打了个空。
lines.en: You struck me and hit nothing.

lines.zh: 我又聚起来了，正对你。
lines.en: I gather again, facing you.

lines.zh: 这一下让你看见了两层。
lines.en: That showed you both layers.

lines.zh: 我的影子也伸了过去。
lines.en: My shadow reached out too.

lines.zh: 你退了，我没追，我在变。
lines.en: You backed off. I didn't follow; I'm changing.

lines.zh: 这一下不太疼，只是不对。
lines.en: That didn't hurt so much as feel wrong.

lines.zh: 我贴着你，让你听清楚。
lines.en: I press close so you hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 你听见两个声音在说话。
lines.en: You hear two voices speaking.

lines.zh: 我抓了一下，又收回来。
lines.en: I snatch once and withdraw.

lines.zh: 这一下，是为了完成。
lines.en: That one was to finish it.

lines.zh: 你别动了，我快好了。
lines.en: Don't move. I'm nearly done.

lines.zh: 好了，变身已经成了。
lines.en: Enough; the transformation is complete.

lines.zh: 我从原来的身体里挣出来。
lines.en: I wrench free of the body I was in.

lines.zh: 先是声音，然后才有形状。
lines.en: First the sound, then the shape.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，不算落地。
lines.en: I land, though landing isn't the word.

lines.zh: 这地方的梦很薄。
lines.en: The dream is thin here.

lines.zh: 我的脸在这一刻分成两半。
lines.en: At this moment my face divides in two.

lines.zh: 我慢慢长高，又缩回去。
lines.en: I grow tall, then pull back down.

lines.zh: 光从我身上往外渗。
lines.en: Light seeps out of me.

lines.zh: 我把手举到眼前，认不出。
lines.en: I hold a hand before my eyes and don't know it.

lines.zh: 我的影子先站稳了。
lines.en: My shadow took its footing first.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有人在叫一个名字。
lines.en: I hear someone far off calling a name.

lines.zh: 这具身体里挤了太多东西。
lines.en: There's too much packed into this body.

lines.zh: 我往前倾，又直起来。
lines.en: I tip forward and right myself.

lines.zh: 我张口，出来的不是我的声音。
lines.en: I open my mouth and it isn't my voice.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地面往下陷了一点。
lines.en: The ground dips slightly where I step.

lines.zh: 我在中间，前后都不是。
lines.en: I'm in between. Neither one nor the other.

lines.zh: 我举起两只手，一只比一只长。
lines.en: I raise both hands. One is longer than the other.

lines.zh: 身边的空气开始错位。
lines.en: The air around me starts to misalign.

lines.zh: 我知道有人在看。
lines.en: I know someone is watching.

lines.zh: 这一段很长，你耐心点。
lines.en: This part is long. Be patient.

lines.zh: 好，这副身体开始拆开了。
lines.en: All right, this body starts coming apart.

lines.zh: 火光照着我的变化，很难看。
lines.en: Firelight shows the change. It's ugly.

lines.zh: 我掉下来，落地的样子不对。
lines.en: I fall, and the landing is wrong.

lines.zh: 水里的我倒映出来，不是人形。
lines.en: My reflection in the water isn't human.

lines.zh: 冲击把我撕开，我又合拢。
lines.en: The blast tears me open and I close again.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过去，孔马上不见了。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and the hole closes at once.

lines.zh: 那力量拧着我的变化。
lines.en: That force twists my change.

lines.zh: 我饿的是这场还没变完的梦。
lines.en: What starves is this unfinished dream.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的轮廓清楚了一瞬。
lines.en: A flash of lightning shows my outline for an instant.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有梦，我变不下去。
lines.en: No dream in the void. I can't finish changing.
